title: Lime, Lemon, and Lichen Dye
summary: Single-use dye that gives compatible equipment a lime, lemon and lichen palette.

fields.Use: Combine it with a compatible equipment item in inventory to recolour the item. The equipment keeps its stats.
fields.Acquisition: Possible stock at traders from party level 5, including Barcus Wroot and Araj Oblodra.
fields.Base value: 6 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
